title: Fix enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps not disabling customCodeCops in workspace compilation
summary: Workspace compilation now correctly disables custom code analyzers when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false, preventing custom analyzer diagnostics from running against test apps.
key_points: Custom analyzers are now cleared in test and BCPT-test folders when enableCodeAnalyzersOnTestApps is false
Previously only built-in analyzers were disabled while custom analyzers continued running
Fix aligns workspace compilation behavior with the documented setting and classic container flow
Mutable buildParams hashtable ensures test folder changes don't affect normal app compilation
Regression tests added to verify correct --customanalyzers argument emission
